title: Federal learning image classification method capable of defending Byzantine attack

pse.problem: Data privacy concerns and vulnerability to Byzantine attacks in federated learning image classification method using Parameter Server structure
pse.solution_function: Robust aggregation algorithm to defend against Byzantine attacks by either calculating aggregate model parameters resistant to attacks (defense-based) or distinguishing malicious workers from benign ones and cleaning the malicious ones during global model aggregation (detection-based)
pse.solution_structure: Working nodes for local model training and server nodes for global model updating
pse.solution_implementation: Iterative process: selection of working nodes for training, preprocessing image data, local model training using latest global model parameters, updating global model with latest local model parameters, broadcasting updated global model to all working nodes
pse.effect: Improved precision and convergence of the global model by preventing Byzantine attacks
